verdict.rationale: Superset ships its own CLI, a static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app and is explicitly documented for managing workspaces, tasks, automations and the local host server "from your terminal or from CI". A TypeScript SDK, a hosted MCP server and an OpenAPI-described API add more programmatic, non-GUI paths, and probes confirm the MCP and API surfaces are live with API-key or OAuth auth. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of real CI pipeline runs, and detailed CI setup docs (e.g. non-interactive auth in CI runners).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use it to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from your terminal or from CI.
The Superset CLI (`superset`) is a single static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app.
The Superset TypeScript SDK lets you create and manage your workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code.
Orchestrate agent work programmatically: create workspaces, launch agents with a prompt, open terminals, and track tasks from another agent or script via the Superset MCP server.
